name: Hayward Rubik's Rumble 2015

venue.name: [Hayward City Hall](http://www.hayward-ca.gov/)
venue.details: The competition will be held in the glass rotunda on the first floor

information: There is a base fee of $5, plus $2 for every event you compete in. NOTE: If you do not register (and pay!) online, you will be subject to a $20 flat fee the day of the competition.
